Naming from the end polygons matches Book 1 lines 88–118 and attached image7.

This adapts Book 1 lines 134–136 and attached image10 using different dimensions.

Independently checked rectangle widths 3, 4 and 5 with common length 7. Each attached triangle has perpendicular legs 3 and 4, with hypotenuse sqrt(3² + 4²) = 5. The triangles attach to opposite 4-unit edges of the middle rectangle; the neighbouring rectangles match their remaining edges. Both right-angle marks and all labels agree with the coordinates. The arrangement forms the specified right triangular prism without overlap or gaps, adapting Book 1 lines 138–142 and attached image11.
